description_en: Queries the automatic snapshot policies that have been created
description_zh: 查询已创建的自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun nas describe-auto-snapshot-policies --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-extreme-233e60000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --file-system-type extreme --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy
parameters.name: auto_snapshot_policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of automatic snapshot policies on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每个分页包含的自动快照策略的个数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
自动快照策略列表的页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The file system type.

Valid value: extreme (Extreme NAS file system)
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统类型。

取值：extreme（极速型NAS）
parameters.name: file_system_type

AutoSnapshotPolicy.description_en: The details of automatic snapshot policies
AutoSnapshotPolicy.description_zh: 自动快照策略详情集合

AutoSnapshotPolicyId.description_en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy

AutoSnapshotPolicyName.description_en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the policy was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) standard in UTC. The format is `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建时间。

按照ISO8601 (https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html)标准表示，并使用UTC时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`

FileSystemNums.description_en: The number of file systems to which the policy is applied
FileSystemNums.description_zh: 启用该策略的文件系统数量

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy
RegionId.description_zh: 自动快照策略所属的地域ID

RepeatWeekdays.description_en:
The days of the week on which automatic snapshots are created.

The cycle is weekly.

Valid values: 1 to 7. For example, 1 indicates Monday
RepeatWeekdays.description_zh:
自动快照的重复日期。

重复周期：星期

取值范围：1~7，例如：1表示周一

RetentionDays.description_en:
The retention period of automatic snapshots.

Unit: days.

Valid values:
-1: Snapshots are permanently retained. When the number of snapshots reaches the quota limit, the earliest snapshots are automatically deleted.
1 to 65536: Snapshots are retained for the specified number of days. Snapshots are subject to automatic release after the retention period expires
RetentionDays.description_zh:
自动快照的保留时间。

单位：天

包括：
-1：永久保存，当快照数量达到额度上限后被自动删除。
1~65536：指定保存天数，保留时间到期后快照会被自动释放

Status.description_en:
The status of the automatic snapshot policy.

Valid values:

Creating: The policy is being created.
Available: The policy is available
Status.description_zh:
自动快照策略状态。

包括：

Creating：创建中
Available：正常可用

TimePoints.description_en:
The points in time at which automatic snapshots are created.

Unit: hours.

Valid values: `0` to `23`, representing 24 points in time from `00:00` to `23:00`. For example, 1 indicates 01:00. You can specify up to 24 points in time, separated by commas (,)
TimePoints.description_zh:
自动快照的创建时间点。

单位：小时

包括：`0~23`，表示从`00:00~23:00`共24个时间点。1代表在01:00时间点。最多24个时间点，用半角逗号（,）隔开

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the automatic snapshot policy list
PageNumber.description_zh: 自动快照策略列表的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页展示返回的自动快照策略时的每页行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of automatic snapshot policies
TotalCount.description_zh: 自动快照策略的总个数
